sentences.text: Appearance:
Shri Anil Kumar Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Satya Pal Chadar - G.A. appearing on behalf of res  ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in custody since 17.02.2025 in connection with Crime No.166/2024 registered at P.S.- Narmadanagar District Khandwa (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A,
376(2)(N) of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that from 06.08.2024 to 17.02.2025, applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that On the date of incident, prosecutrix was aged more than 17 years.
It is urged that prosecutrix and applicant have resided together from 06.08.2024 to 17.02.2025 and they also performed marriage.
It is case of consensual relationship.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant is in jail since 17.02.2025.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17307 2 MCRC-12369-2025 5.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having regard to prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE sm Shantilal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187715787/
